oauth.githubExplainer: By signing in with GitHub, you can use your existing GitHub account to access our services. This allows for a seamless login experience and eliminates the need to create a new account. Your GitHub credentials will not be shared with us, and we will only request the necessary permissions to authenticate your identity.
oauth.fortyTwoExplainer: By signing in with 42, you can use your existing 42 account to access our services. This allows for a seamless login experience and eliminates the need to create a new account. Your 42 credentials will not be shared with us, and we will only request the necessary permissions to authenticate your identity.
